common.portal_tagline: Citizen-Centric Land Record Verification & Grievance Resolution Platform
common.banner_legal_notice: Official Land Record Verification Layer. Final legal authority rests with jurisdiction officers.

landing.hero_title: Transparent Land Record Verification & Discrepancy Resolution
landing.hero_subtitle: Locate land parcels, compare reference registries against title evidence with AI assistance, and track grievance resolution with jurisdiction revenue officers.
landing.step1_desc: Search by District, Taluk, Village, or Survey Number to identify assigned revenue officers and reference land records.
landing.step2_desc: Submit your registered deed or patta document to flag potential mismatches in area, survey number, or ownership.
landing.step3_desc: Gemini AI extracts document text and compares it against reference records to generate advisory verification findings.
landing.step4_desc: Jurisdiction Tahsildars review findings, request evidence, resolve grievances, or escalate cases within SLA deadlines.

access.title: Choose your workspace
access.subtitle: Select your designated role to enter your specialized workspace with role-specific tools, permissions, and workflows.
access.citizen_desc: Submit and track grievances. Locate your land parcel, reference official Patta & Survey records, upload deed evidence, and receive real-time status updates.
access.officer_desc: Review and resolve assigned cases. Inspect 3-column evidence screens, verify AI discrepancy findings, request additional documents, or escalate within SLA deadlines.
access.admin_desc: Monitor the platform and operations. Configure jurisdiction mappings, reassign officers, configure SLA rules, and audit immutable system logs.

citizen.dashboard_subtitle: Track live status, SLA deadlines, and officer actions for your submitted land grievances.

officer.queue_subtitle: Review assigned cases, inspect AI field comparisons, and execute verification actions.
